name: Estimator-agreement moneyline
signal: Both estimators name the same winner AND their margin estimates differ by less than the median disagreement of the slate.

thresholds.max_disagreement_pts: median of the slate, computed at build time

universe: every game in the T+0..T+3 window whose two clubs are both inside the luck noise band (|luck z| <= 2.0)
settlement_rule: Official NBA final score. Win if the named side wins in regulation or overtime. A game with no official final is left UNGRADED and never counted as a loss.
